name: Data Engineer agent
why: Designs a pipeline with raw, cleaned and report-ready layers, quality checks, freshness targets and alerts, the same shape as the pipeline spec skill.

name: Data warehouse query reviewer
why: Reviews warehouse SQL for join and privacy errors with a read-only plan, a useful check on models before they ship.

name: Align recurring report metric definitions
why: Produces a metric difference table and reconciled examples, the starting point when two reports disagree.

name: Report definition drift review assistant
why: Finds where a recurring report's definition changed, which explains many 'numbers don't match' tickets.

name: Excel table join reconciler
why: Joins two tables on a key and reports unmatched rows, the same tie-out habit the reconciliation skill uses.

name: Data file clean-up loop
why: Fixes and re-checks a messy file until it passes and saves the rules, handy for sources that arrive as files.

name: Define your metrics once and write a weekly update
why: Writes the metric definitions the marts must produce, so models and reports agree.

name: Agent database setup planner
why: Plans a schema, migration steps, access rules and a staging test, useful when the destination is Postgres.

name: Build a backup recovery rehearsal
why: Plans a safe restore test, the habit behind checking time travel and copies before any overwrite.

name: Recovery rehearsal evidence assistant
why: Checks restore evidence against recovery targets, a companion to the run book workflow.

name: Release manager
why: Gives a go or no-go, changelog and rollback plan before each release, the same gate as the pipeline change workflow.

name: Process doc freshness keeper
why: Finds stale or ownerless process docs each month, which keeps run books current.

name: Monthly tracking health keeper
why: Checks platform numbers against store totals each month, the tie-out that catches broken ad and analytics sources.
